channel.title: NinjaTom Apps Project Updates
channel.description: New and updated apps, games, tools, and creative technology from NinjaTom Apps.

item.title: Mind Deck
item.description: A focused thought-card app for prompts, reflection, and deliberate mental resets. Mind Deck has a public product preview and current mobile/tablet interfaces while its App Store listing remains in preparation.

item.title: DreamSpell
item.description: A modern companion for the Dreamspell calendar, daily kin, oracle, and reflective practice. DreamSpell is a long-running App Store product modernized and maintained with a current 2026 release and canonical dreamspell.app destination.

item.title: QuitGentle
item.description: A calm smoking-cessation tracker with progress cues, check-ins, and optional Premium tools. QuitGentle is publicly available on the App Store. AshTag remains an internal source alias and is not a separate public product.

item.title: CUSTOS / We Are the Watchers
item.description: A watchful creative brand and product-world concept exploring identity, artifacts, and a first public collection. The public brand site is available, but checkout and a public product launch are not claimed. CUSTOS and We Are the Watchers are presented as one identity, not duplicate projects.

item.title: Zen Wisdom
item.description: Quiet daily reflections and timeless teachings, modernized for today’s Apple devices. Zen Wisdom is a long-running App Store product modernized and maintained with a current 2026 update.

item.title: DoorCodes
item.description: Access codes, ready on arrival with privacy-safe reminders and Secure Reveal. DoorCodes is publicly available on the App Store with a dedicated product site, support path, privacy policy, and release artwork.

item.title: MealBot Express
item.description: A four-world, free-roam competitive arcade delivery game built for couch and online multiplayer. The University Campus build is the playable foundation for a larger game with Night City, Jersey Shore / Boardwalk, a player-voted fourth world, upgradeable MealBots, power-ups, progression, leaderboards, cosmetics, and short-session replay loops.

item.title: Ninja Tom’s Rooftop Rush
item.description: A fast chapter-driven rooftop arcade game built around movement, gadgets, evidence, and style. The game has a complete multi-chapter release-candidate path and current gameplay media. Human playability, final media approval, and release authorization remain open.

item.title: MasterSpaces
item.description: A macOS workspace utility for organizing spaces, ideas, and repeatable project workflows. MasterSpaces is a direct-download release candidate. Public download follows notarization and clean-machine QA.

item.title: FlowGuru
item.description: A community and focus platform exploring practical tools for creative momentum and getting unstuck. A staged foundation and public preview exist while product scope, release, domain, and commercial decisions remain in development.

item.title: Shramana
item.description: A contemplative iPad puzzle game with twenty authored levels, monk abilities, and accessible play systems. The app target, campaign, release tooling, and extensive validation exist; physical-device and final release gates remain.

item.title: SwiftTerm
item.description: A polished terminal companion for command notes, remote sessions, and fast developer workflows. SwiftTerm has a public product preview and release-preparation materials; a public App Store listing is not yet verified.

item.title: Don’t Speed
item.description: A route-aware speed companion designed for clear alerts, safer pacing, and trip review. A release-candidate build is active in TestFlight. Physical route, locked-screen, audio, and final release approval remain before public launch.

item.title: CushionOps
item.description: A focused operations system for repeatable work, readiness tracking, and practical team execution. CushionOps remains active development. The former public Pages URL is unavailable, so this portfolio detail replaces the broken external link without claiming launch.

item.title: DeadHead Detective
item.description: A gig-driving profitability utility that separates paid miles from deadhead miles and turns trips into useful insight. Current interfaces cover the dashboard, active trips, history, and profitability insights. No public App Store release is claimed.

item.title: RetroCopter
item.description: A compact retro arcade flight game built around responsive controls and quick replay loops. A playable product and public gameplay preview exist; App Store availability remains pending final review.

item.title: NinjaTom Arcade: Pinball Dojo
item.description: A watchOS-first pinball game with SpriteKit physics, Digital Crown controls, and belt-rank progression. The Master Dojo table is playable, simulator builds and logic tests pass, and a signed release archive exists. Distribution signing and final watch captures remain.

item.title: WristMaze
item.description: A twenty-level Apple Watch maze adventure with tilt controls, hazards, progression, and Game Center systems. The campaign, complication, progression, accessibility, audio, and Game Center code paths are implemented. Real-watch tuning and App Store Connect completion remain.

item.title: Geometric Alchemy
item.description: Custom 3D-printed art, geometric objects, and fabrication work presented through a live public storefront. Custom3D.Art currently routes to the Geometric Alchemy public storefront. Store availability is verified without making individual inventory claims.

item.title: LumaFlow
item.description: An active Apple-platform product build progressing through runtime QA and provisioning gates. LumaFlow is represented without an external link because similarly named public domains belong to unrelated products. Runtime QA and release setup remain active work.

item.title: Grateful Dicks
item.description: An adult-humor character and merchandise concept lab developing an original visual identity and public-interest test. The project remains a concept lab with a public teaser. Nothing is represented here as manufactured, for sale, affiliated, or officially launched.

item.title: Watcher.One
item.description: A local-first AI cohost and live-production system connecting overlays, recaps, chat, memory, and avatar workflows. A locally testable MVP exists. Public streaming remains gated by external accounts, production direction, operator validation, and cost approval.

item.title: ReloadSmith
item.description: A Unity hot-reload and iteration toolkit developed to shorten editor feedback loops and support repeatable project validation. ReloadSmith is represented as an internal developer tool. No Asset Store or public-package availability is claimed.

item.title: Mission Control Watch
item.description: A private watchOS attention surface for secure owner notifications, acknowledgement, and bounded reminders. This is an owner-only internal tool in active private development. No App Store, TestFlight, public enrollment, or infrastructure details are offered.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Mission Control
item.description: A private operations dashboard joining local status, weather, input, and workshop control into one resilient interface. The dashboard and local input path have working owner evidence. Network, device, camera, and endpoint details remain private by design.

item.title: Fabrication & Venue Vending
item.description: A planned fabrication and venue-commerce system connecting inventory, QR ordering, displays, and lead workflows. The initiative is in investigation and planning. It is presented as a future operating system, not a launched storefront or vending network.
